_comment: v11 ANALOG-SENSE CHANNEL MAP -- the single machine-readable source for the
ADS1115 channel/address assignment (ADR-148) and for the divider values.
NO BOARD EXISTS for v11; this describes the SCHEMATIC, not routed copper.

adc.vdd_nominal_note: +3V3 from TPS7A02 (U7). SBAS444E s5.3 operating range 2..5.5 V.
adc.lsb_note: SBAS444E Table 7-1: FSR +/-4.096 V -> LSB 125 uV (16-bit, 2^15 codes per polarity).
adc.abs_max_pin_current_note: SBAS444E s5.1 'Input current, continuous, any pin except power supply pins' -10..10 mA. s9.1.3 repeats 10 mA and calls it a stress rating, not a functional target.
fsr_choice_note: FSR +/-2.048 V leaves only ~29 LSB of headroom above the documented cold-Voc fault
(2.10 V at the pin) and no margin for the estimate being wrong. FSR +/-6.144 V cannot
deliver full scale at VDD = 3.3 V (SBAS444E s7.3.3 footnote 1 and its worked example).
+/-4.096 V at VDD 3.3 V measures 0..3.3 V single-ended with LSB 125 uV, matching the
datasheet's own VDD=3.3 V / FSR=+/-4.096 V example.

voltage_envelope.source_document: docs/analysis/wing-electrical.md s5.1 (reproduced in docs/analysis/array-power-architecture.md s2 and docs/analysis/mppt-charge-path-specification.md s2)
voltage_envelope.vsolar_p_cold_voc_basis: 12 cells x V_OC,cell(-60 C); V_OC,cell = 0.62 V + (-2.1 mV/C/cell)(-85 C) = 0.7985 V
voltage_envelope.vscap_post_bat54_basis: 9.58 V - 0.3 V BAT54 forward drop (wing-electrical s5.1). There is NO clamp in the accepted design (ADR-047 s7.3, wing-electrical s5.2), so this is a reachable node voltage, not a hypothetical.
voltage_envelope.qualification: ESTIMATE, NOT MEASUREMENT. Both coefficients (V_OC(25 C)=0.62 V, -2.1 mV/(C.cell)) are TODO(unverified) in wing-electrical s5.1; the cell datasheet is not in this repo. The DIVIDER IS SIZED TO SURVIVE THE ESTIMATE BEING WRONG by 50 %.

wired_note: RESERVED, NOT WIRED. The cut-sense element is a 10 mOhm series shunt that
belongs to v11 item 3 (real cut driver), which is out of this change's scope.
ADS1115 input power-sequence qualification is also BLOCKED - see
unused analog input is tied to GND, which is what the registry does. The
CHANNEL ALLOCATION is pinned here so item 3 cannot silently choose another.

devices.function: rail telemetry (/VSCAP + three solar stack taps)

dividers.max_source_basis: vscap_post_bat54_cold_voc_v -- the documented UNCLAMPED over-voltage path (no clamp exists in the accepted design)
why_changed: A 0.5 ratio puts 4.64 V on the ADS1115 pin at the documented 9.28 V fault.
SBAS444E s5.1 absolute maximum is VDD+0.3 = 3.6 V, so the inherited divider would
destroy the ADC in exactly the fault the board exists to observe.
dividers.night_budget: 1.915 uA / 10.34 uW at 5.4 V (v10's 1M/1M was 2.70 uA / 14.58 uW per ADR-047 s6)

dividers.max_source_basis: same string, 9-cell tap -- sized for the FULL 12-cell cold Voc (conservative)
same string, 6-cell tap -- sized for the FULL 12-cell cold Voc (conservative)

stack_note: The four wings are in SERIES (registry: J_W1.4=/W1_SOLAR_N=J_W2.1; J_W2.4=/W2_SOLAR_N=J_W3.1;
J_W3.4=/W3_SOLAR_N=J_W4.1; J_W4.4=GND). Only THREE independent nodes exist and all three are
Wing voltages 1-3 are DIFFERENCES of adjacent measured nodes.
LIMITATION, stated not hidden: wing 4's own terminal voltage is NOT directly measurable --
its positive node is /W3_SOLAR_N, which is measured, but subtracting GND yields the WHOLE
string, not wing 4. ADR-148 spent all eight channels (4 cut + VSCAP + 3 solar); there is no spare.

pullup_finding: MEASURED on hub_board_v10.kicad_pcb: the I2C bus has NO pull-up resistors at all.
The only pads on /I2C_SCL and /I2C_SDA are U1.38/U1.39 and U6.7/U6.8. ADR-145
justified the expander with 'the bus already exists and is already routed' -
routed yes, but with no pull-ups the bus cannot function beyond the ESP32-S3's
weak (~45 kOhm) internal pull-ups. Adding two more devices to it requires real
pull-ups, so v11 adds them. Idle current is zero (both lines high, no DC path);
they only draw during traffic, which is not a night-budget item.

address_collisions.basis: SDO/CSB pin strap. Either strap is clear of the ADS1115's 0x48-0x4B block.

address_collisions.device: MCP23017 (ADR-145, NOT fitted in this revision)

protection.absmax_note: SBAS444E s5.1: analog input AINx max = VDD+0.3 = 3.6 V at VDD 3.3 V; continuous input current on any non-supply pin is +/-10 mA.
protection.dissipation_basis: 1/16 W (62.5 mW) continuous for a standard 0402 thick-film chip resistor.
protection.note: Two independent limits, the tighter one quoted. Pin current reaches 10 mA only at 471 V source, by which point R_top (220k, 0402) is dissipating 614 mW and has long since failed. R_top dissipation therefore binds first, at 150.3 V = 15.7x the documented 9.58 V cold Voc. Below 16.38 V source the tap is under the 3.6 V absolute maximum and the pin current is zero, so the clamp is not even conducting.

address_collisions_note: U_ADC1 (0x48) and U_ADC2 (0x49) are listed under 'devices', not here; this list is
OTHER traffic on the same bus. ADS1115 offers four addresses (0x48-0x4B) via
ADDR->GND/VDD/SDA/SCL (SBAS444E Table 7-2), so two more are available later.

i2c_pullups.basis: SBAS444E s9.1.6: 1k to 10k typ, one set per bus; four devices max. Bus has U1(ESP32-S3), U6(MS5611), U_ADC1, U_ADC2 = 4 loads.
i2c_pullups.why_added: hub_board_v10.kicad_pcb has NO pull-up resistors on /I2C_SCL or /I2C_SDA; verified via pcbnew. ADR-145 assumed the bus was usable as-is.

input_impedance_basis.citation: SBAS444E s5.5 Electrical Characteristics - the 15 MOhm figure is TYP, not guaranteed.
